adapter.rate_note: IP limit: 'You are allowed to send 600 requests within a 5-second window per IP by default'; exceeding it answers '403, access too frequent' and a ban of at least 10 minutes; X-Bapi-Limit / X-Bapi-Limit-Status / X-Bapi-Limit-Reset-Timestamp headers (https://bybit-exchange.github.io/docs/v5/rate-limit). Kept to 20 per second.

me.note: Public API, no credentials: the probe is GET /v5/market/time ({retCode, retMsg, result.timeSecond, result.timeNano}).

get_candles.note: `category=linear` (USDT/USDC perpetuals, the collector's scope) is fixed. result.list rows are positional arrays [startTime, openPrice, highPrice, lowPrice, closePrice, volume, turnover] sorted newest first and mapped by index (`raw.values` keeps the row). `interval` uses Bybit's values 1, 3, 5, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360, 720, D, W, M; `start`/`end` are epoch MILLISECONDS (pass the number as a string); limit 1-1000, default 200. Bybit reports request errors inside HTTP 200 as retCode != 0 (retMsg), which then surfaces as an empty candle list — check `raw`. Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema). Failures answer HTTP 200 with a non-zero retCode (e.g. 10001 'params error: Symbol Is Invalid'); the envelope turns them into isError results instead of an empty candle list (live check 2026-09-26).

search_symbols.note: `category=linear` is fixed (required by the endpoint). No text search: `query` is sent as the exact `symbol` filter (e.g. BTCUSDT) and the first `limit` (default 500, max 1000) linear instruments come back when it is omitted; paging is by cursor (result.nextPageCursor), which `page` cannot carry. `name` is the baseCoin, `type` the contractType; status, quoteCoin, leverageFilter, priceFilter, lotSizeFilter stay in `raw`.

not_offered.get_series: Funding-rate history (GET /v5/market/funding/history) and open interest (GET /v5/market/open-interest) are documented, but the market_data get_series input has no symbol/category split and no interval, and both need epoch-millisecond start/end; not mapped in this pass.
not_offered.get_news: No news endpoint on this API.
